review_scope: Read-only native ACT1 contract review, no game control/process access/normal-save reads/closed-state reads/source edits. Evidence outputs only in this directory.

command_input.getter_contract: return actor+0x2384 when nonzero, else literal address 0xB5DE68; do not dereference B5DE68 as pointer

command_input.level_semantics: 8BA030 uses unsigned max priority on acquire, clears only when stored level <= release level; not a reference count
limits: Zero means this gate is open, not that world movement must occur.

Existing command list and actor/scene gates, physical focus, click autowalk, chat text input and other controllers are outside this predicate.

official_elf_scope.business_distinction: Server ELF has packet/user-state validation (for example DisPatcher_MoveMap::read/process); that is not a client keyboard/UI admission contract and cannot establish these ACT1 addresses or root visibility.

minimum_live_acceptance: Keep four owned clients, same process identities, protected normal saves. No need to replay completed unrelated matrices.

For each role separately: town idle with known zero or observed initial level, Enter into empty chat, poll known nonzero scoped lock and try a short original direction key, Esc cancel without sending chat, poll zero/restored movement; other three remain controls.
Record pointer/UID/checker stability, before/during/after raw level and scoped Boolean. Do not infer a reason from dialog count.

Open/cancel an already authorized native confirmation once and record class/root active registration, close exclusion, high-layer attachment/order/raw layer flags. Do not require it to block keyboard unless exact gate actually changes.
